_comment: Every balance knob in the game. See src/engine/balance.ts for what each field does and why. RESCALED when Armour was removed and Skill took over mitigation: a level-1 character now opens at 9-14 health rather than 40-70, so every stat-scale number here came down with it (skillCurveK, perPoint, healing). Rewards and prices did not — they are not on the stat scale. Re-measure with `npm run simulate:progression` after touching any of it. NOTE: never stock a grantGold consumable whose payout exceeds its price; that is an infinite-gold loop.

roles._comment: What each role DOES beyond its stat block. See src/engine/balance.ts.

partyScaling._comment: Enemy ATTACK is SUB-LINEAR in headcount (atkPerDoubling = per DOUBLING of the party, not per head); HP stays linear (hpPerExtraMember). The old per-head atkPerExtraMember is gone, not deprecated - it is what made the top of the ladder unreachable: at 0.24 a party of 25 met 5.8x attack while their own HP had not moved, so Woop Woop read 0-7% at EVERY headcount from 5 to 30 and Ladies of The Knight never won. Measured sweep (7 curves x 3 dungeons x 10 headcounts): 0.65 gives the top of the ladder a real turnout curve without flattening it to a guaranteed win, which 0.45 did. 0.65 per doubling is ~2.9x at forty players; do not read it as a per-head number. Re-measure with `npm run simulate:progression` section 11 after touching any of it.
